run.decision: FAIL / NO_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED. The frozen 日K高速002 bullish volatility-compression continuation rule failed the preregistered all-gates decision. The fixed one-third combined path produced 0.043926% CAGR, 0.038904 Sharpe and 7.685948% MDD versus 0.478848% CAGR for CNY cash. Average net round-trip return was -0.026984% with profit factor 0.870708; only 4/7 fixed folds had positive Sharpe. No standalone asset outperformed cash and gold completed only 112 round trips. The matched compression control was materially worse (-1.004881% CAGR, -0.373520 Sharpe), showing that the SMA(50) trend gate helped but did not create a tradable edge. At 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, combined CAGR fell to -1.517273%, Sharpe to -1.084620 and MDD rose to 32.075415%. Gross exposure, nonnegative cash and zero-overnight-position invariants passed. Per the stop rule, no SMA/ATR/compression/close-location/take-profit tuning, asset deletion, factor addition, stop-loss, dynamic sizing or execution rescue is permitted in this trial. The index OHLC paths remain non-investable execution proxies.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After any formal metric is viewed, do not tune or replace SMA/ATR lookbacks, compression multiple, close-location threshold, take-profit multiple, allocation, asset set, exit timing, fee, or slippage inside this trial. Do not add RSI, volume, calendar, stop-loss, overnight, asset-specific or dynamic-sizing rescue variants. Any such mechanism is a new trial and must be preregistered with the complete family counted before results.
pass_fail_gates: at least two of three standalone assets have full-period CAGR above the CNY cash control
at least two of three standalone assets have full-period Sharpe >0
each standalone asset has at least 150 completed round trips
fixed one-third combined CAGR >= CNY cash CAGR +2.00 percentage points
fixed one-third combined Sharpe > C-COMPRESSION-COMBINED Sharpe
fixed one-third combined average net round-trip return >0 and profit factor >=1.05
at least 5/7 fixed time folds have combined Sharpe >0
combined 2020+ CAGR and 2022+ CAGR are each greater than full-window CNY cash CAGR
with 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, combined CAGR remains above CNY cash CAGR and Sharpe >0.50
maximum intraday gross <=100%, minimum end-of-day cash >=0 and overnight position days =0
methodology.selection_metric: No within-family selection. There is exactly one cross-asset rule; all three standalone paths, the fixed one-third combined path, matched controls and execution stress are reported, and PASS requires every preregistered gate.

run.title: INDEPENDENT_INTRADAY_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_CONTINUATION_V1

strategies.description: During an intact 50-session uptrend, a T-1 true range no greater than 0.75 times the prior 14-session ATR together with a close in the upper quartile indicates constrained selling and incomplete information diffusion. Buying the next open and exiting at open plus 0.25 ATR, or at the same-session close if unfilled, should add repeatable net return across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500 after the user-specified fee without overnight risk.

version.mechanism_text: During an intact 50-session uptrend, a T-1 true range no greater than 0.75 times the prior 14-session ATR together with a close in the upper quartile indicates constrained selling and incomplete information diffusion. Buying the next open and exiting at open plus 0.25 ATR, or at the same-session close if unfilled, should add repeatable net return across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500 after the user-specified fee without overnight risk.

allowed_changes: one fixed cross-asset rule: previous close above trailing SMA(50), previous true range no greater than 0.75 times the 14-session ATR ending at T-2, and previous close location at least 0.75
enter at the current real OHLC open and set the same-session take-profit to open plus 0.25 times the frozen T-2 ATR(14)
if the current high reaches the frozen take-profit, exit at that target; otherwise exit at the current close
standalone 100% sleeve runs for gold_cny, nasdaq and sp500 plus one fixed one-third-per-asset combined run
matched compression controls that remove only the SMA(50) trend gate, a CNY demand-cash control and one preregistered 0.05% adverse-slippage execution stress
forbidden_changes: reading current-session high, low or close before the opening buy decision
including the T-1 compression bar or any T-session range in the ATR baseline
any SMA, ATR, compression, close-location or take-profit parameter grid or post-result threshold change
asset-specific parameters or dropping a weak gold, Nasdaq or S&P 500 component
adding RSI, MACD, volume, calendar or another factor after viewing this result
adding a stop-loss, holding overnight or changing the close liquidation rule
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, negative target weights, gross exposure above 100% or negative end-of-day cash
changing the user-specified 0.005% per-fill fee or hiding the preregistered slippage stress
representing index OHLC execution as directly investable product evidence

shared_rules.atr_baseline_end: T-2; excludes the T-1 compression bar
shared_rules.entry: buy current session open after the open-time causal signal passes
shared_rules.exit: sell at open + 0.25 * frozen prior ATR if current high reaches it; otherwise sell current close
shared_rules.trend_rule: previous close > mean of the 50 closes ending at previous close
